title: Execute Cross-Domain E2E Test Suite and Pre-Flight Commercial Release Gate Verification

Run complete pre-flight release gate validation across all test suites (lint, build, adapters, orchestrator, roles, knowledge-state, curriculum, browser)

Modifying live production database schema or executing unreviewed database migrations

acceptance_criteria: 100% of headless browser test journeys across all 4 domains pass without DOM defects or console errors

risks: Automated browser tests timing out on resource-constrained environments. Mitigation: Maintain generous retry windows and clean headless process termination.
